items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: and his name was Ford Leary.

ctx.x: He was in that band when I was connected with it, and of course, that is where I ran into Lena Horne. Charley Barnet was in New York City, and he had a trombone player with him at that time that played trombone with a valve -- a bass trombone where you could hit that low note with that key, you know, and his name was Ford Leary. A big guy. He had four trombone players, and Ford Leary was the guy that Barnet featured singing Shadrack.
